media.alt: A 20 second video. Owner Justin Myrick walks into the long, empty former DMV room in Orange Park where the Fore Motion Golf bays go, one arm out toward the old service counter. The shot softly dissolves into a 3D concept view of the finished venue, labeled Concept, that starts high over the whole floor plan and pushes slowly down toward the four simulator bays. On screen: Owner Justin Myrick walks the space. The space, as planned. It ends on a deep green card: Join the Founders List, Follow the build, Opening early 2027, foremotiongolf.com. The Fore Motion Golf logo is at the top and foremotiongolf.com at the foot throughout.

Owner Justin Myrick walks along a long service counter in the empty former DMV, one arm out toward the wall, under numbered window signs. The Fore Motion Golf logo sits at the top, and a deep green panel below reads Owner Justin Myrick walks the space, with foremotiongolf.com.
